lines.zh: 手臂摆得很大，我走得张扬
lines.en: My arms swing wide; I walk brashly.
My bracer knocks against my side guard.
I land on the balls of my feet.
I hold my stride back, winding up.
My aura flattens the grass aside.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方尘土不落
lines.en: Dust will not settle where I pass.
All that pride walks very steadily.
I narrow my eyes at the distance.
A prince's pace needs no hurry.
I drop a shoulder and half-turn.
My heel strikes; the ground answers.
Arms folded, I stand very straight.

lines.zh: 战斗力一千三百万，不算多
lines.en: Thirteen million. Not much.
I think about winning, not losing.
Ki rolls once around my waist.
I clench my jaw tight.
I cannot be bothered to wipe the sweat.
Again he was one step ahead of me.
I have never accepted defeat.
My fingers tap the bracer.
I kick a pebble away.
When the wind stops, I notice the silence.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把脖子转了半圈
lines.en: I tilt my head and roll my neck.
This armor feels light as cloth.
One more round. Just one.
Your ki is not worth mentioning.
Do you know who I am?
Stand straight; do not hunch.
I dislike being met eye to eye.
You are hesitating; I can tell.
I did not come to make friends.
I grant you one chance to speak.
From that angle you cannot reach me.
I rotate my bracer half a turn.
What are you smiling at?
I am stronger than you. That is a fact.
If you disagree, try me.
My eyes have not left you.
Nobody is behind you; I checked.
I crack my knuckles at my chest.
Do not stand directly in front of me.
I clench my teeth and give half a step.
This wound barely stings.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
My ki guard took half.
I steady myself so no one notices.
The pain makes me want the win more.
I press my arm.
You have some strength.
I will own that hit.
Another round.
I have no use for such things.
You eat it yourself.
I am hungry, but not for handouts.
Set it down; I can take it myself.
After training.

lines.zh: 这点东西连热身都不够
lines.en: This will not even warm me up.
I take it, and we forget it happened.
Do not measure me with food.
If there is meat, fine.
I will fight again after eating.
You hit me; you are the one who moves.
I stand firmer than a pillar.
I do not yield the road.
After the bump I straighten my collar.
One shoulder and you stagger.
Do not test me with your shoulder.
I raise a hand; ki pushes you off.
That shove had some weight.
We both give a step.
Bump me again and I answer.
Royalty chooses a partner by strength.
You cannot take one of my punches.
That would require someone my equal.
I need no one to look after me.
I fold my arms tighter.
Beat me first, then we talk.
My pride outweighs my life.
A companion can only be the strong.
I have no time for such thoughts.
Take the last rank.
I bend and rise quickly.
This has some weight to it.
I toss it up and catch it.
Not what I am looking for.
I toss it carelessly aside.

lines.zh: 手里多一件，出拳慢一分
lines.en: One more item slows a punch by a fraction.
I squeeze it; too soft.
This could pad a bracer.
I kick it to the roadside.
Leave that to the weak.

lines.zh: 让我看看你有几分本事
lines.en: Let me see what you are worth.
Galick Gun. Can you take it?
Ki churns in my palm.
I do not need to transform for this.
Your movements are too slow.
I have your centerline.
I want this win clean.
First I pin your left hand.
You retreated too soon.
Do not think I fear your weapon.
I drop low, ready to rush.
I lift ki to my shoulders.
One step at a time; no rush.
I let you strike first.
Stand still.
I am at your left; do not turn.
Your breathing changed twice.
Your feet are searching for ground.

lines.zh: 我的气已经锁住你的位置。
lines.en: My ki has already locked onto your position.
I have drilled this move a thousand times.
A volley can seal the whole path.
Your armor is loose at the shoulder.

lines.zh: 你越急越容易露出空隙
lines.en: The more you hurry, the more you open up.
The aerial combo needs altitude.
I set my foot and crush a stone.
This range is close enough.
I have calculated your retreat.
I can go a little faster.
You have only one way left.
Aerial combination, top down.
A straight punch at your chest.
I land knee first.
A knife-hand at your wrist.
Three blows, steady rhythm.

lines.zh: 你挡了一下，第二下漏了
lines.en: You blocked one; the second got through.
A ki blast bursts close in.
That punch was only half.
A round kick sweeps your ankle.

lines.zh: 肘击撞上护甲，声音很闷
lines.en: Elbow on armor, a dull sound.
I raise an arm and bat your counter aside.
One breath; nothing serious.
The third punch ends at my chest.
The punch wind tears the dust.
Again; do not keep me waiting.
My aura opens; the grass lies flat.
An unfamiliar place again.
First I work my wrists.
The smell here is wrong.
Armor fastened, I stand tall.
Not many people around.
I draw my ki into a line.

lines.zh: 地面被我的气推出纹路
lines.en: My aura presses patterns into the ground.
I look up at this sky.
First time I have been here.
No rival, a wasted trip.
I stand high for a better view.
My shoulders settle; I stand firm.
Wind lifts my coat hem.
I wait a second to see who moves.
A battlefield needs no manners.
I turn my toes forward.
Fire scorches my bracer.
My heel goes numb on landing.
The water crushes my lungs.
The blast pushes me back two steps.
An arrow finds a seam in my shoulder guard.
The spell stalls my ki.
Hunger makes my punches hollow.

lines.zh: 电流顺着护甲走遍全身
lines.en: Current runs through my armor.
Nothing to plant a foot on.
